title: 3 Iconic Star Wars Hairstyles Tutorial!
description:
Here's a hair tutorial on 3 iconic Star Wars hairstyles! You've seen these on Leia, Padme, and Rey; now you can learn to do them on yourself!

I think the style of the hair in Star Wars is incredible! And I love looking at how people cosplay them. Today's hairstyles are from The Force Awakens, The Attack of the Clones, and A New Hope. And I just realized they're all buns! How funny! Overall, I was really happy to do tutorials on these hair styles from the leading ladies of StarWars!
